name: Self-hosted Esplora / electrs instance of the organisation (BTC, LTC)
operator: The organisation running V3LUM (settings btc_explorers_esplora_url, btc_explorers_esplora_ltc_url)
tier_rationale: Instance operated by the company or a contracted processor (A12: disclosure 'internal'); P211 cond 1 'a configured self-hosted esplora_url is always tried first' and the btc_esplora_internal class for TLP:AMBER+ and RED cases.

reliability.justification: Own Esplora/electrs index of the public ledger: chain facts, as fresh as the node's sync state.

esplora.title: Self-hosted Esplora REST API (same paths as blockstream.info/api)

terms.quote: a configured self-hosted esplora_url is always tried first. With one disclosure class per module (A8 BR7), the self-hosted path is also a class btc_esplora_internal (disclosure 'internal', no public failover) for TLP:AMBER+ and RED cases.

esplora.notes: Quote: binding council text (P211 cond 1). Esplora server software is MIT-licensed (research C0474) and runs on the organisation's own infrastructure: no third party receives the address. https base URLs only (hosts_from_settings): btc_explorers_esplora_url for BTC, btc_explorers_esplora_ltc_url for LTC (e.g. https://esplora.corp.example/api). Used by btc_explorers (first adapter) and btc_esplora_internal (only adapter).

notes: Owned by batch p2-G09-2 (P211). Virtual internal provider: hosts come from the two https URL settings only; without them btc_esplora_internal is SKIPPED config.
